item.text:
The audit now has 16 confirmed findings. The latest additions are:

- **`read(usize::MAX)` panics** with integer overflow instead of returning the documented `None` for an out-of-bounds index.
- **`ConfigError::InvalidConfig` has a cyclic error chain**: repeatedly following `source()` never terminates.
- **Duplicate node IDs pass validation**, including `[1, 1]`, which cannot provide the two distinct promises required by its configured quorum.

Validation also established:

- Default `cargo check --workspace --all-targets` passes.
- All 24 shipped runtime tests pass with `--all-features`.
- All 160 randomized LRU clone/decode runs pass, confirming the value corruption is LFU-specific.
- The all-feature workspace check fails in `examples/kv_store_async` due `Entry`/`unicache` feature unification, retained as a build-matrix limitation.

The main unresolved high-impact defects remain delta-snapshot corruption, LFU cache value corruption, and leaked persistent atomic writes. Complete evidence, reproduction commands, and retained logs are in [report.md](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-17_22-19-35-omnipaxos-baseline/work/report.md).
